classifiedFinding.title: External NFT mints accelerate runway depletion via latestPrice growth without consent of stakers or operator

classification.assetImpact: Runway predictability impact only. Existing stakers receive higher absolute rewards, so they are not directly griefed; the operator's seeded budget drains faster than the configured cadence implies. With growthBasisPoints == 0, this surface vanishes.
attackPath: 1. Operator seeds NFTStaker with budget V intended for a 12-month runway at expected mint cadence.
2. Attacker mints aggressively at the dispatcher, pushing price up geometrically.
3. Next user interaction triggers _recomputeSchedule, recomputing R against the new latestPrice.
4. R rises sharply; windowEnd = now + budget / R collapses; runway shrinks. Operator forced into reactive top-up or accept depletion.
classification.likelihood: low - growthBasisPoints == 0 collapses the surface; with non-zero growth, the attacker pays mint costs without direct profit.
classification.assumptions: growthBasisPoints > 0; mint cost is below the value of the runway perturbation to the attacker.

classifiedFinding.justification: Low. Runway-predictability finding with no asset theft. Existing stakers materially benefit from the perturbation; only the operator's planning is impacted. Recommendation: document or cap latestPrice growth between recomputes.
